devdoc.details: Deployed behind a TransparentUpgradeableProxy. Uses a fixed storage slot      (ERC-7201) to avoid storage collisions across upgrades.

EnforcedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is paused.

ExpectedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is not paused.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

Initialized(uint64).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

getState().details: Not guarded by whenNotPaused — admin can inspect state even when paused.

params.maxDifferencePercent_: Max allowed TVL change (18-dec fraction, e.g. 0.05e18 = 5 %).
params.owner_: Address that will own the contract.
params.updater_: Address authorized to push rate updates.

lockQuorum().details: Requires zkEnabled to be true, quorumThreshold ≥ 2 (locking threshold 1      is a no-op), and at least that many verifiers configured.

lockZkEnabled().details: Requires zkEnabled to be true and enough verifiers for the current quorum.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

setQuorumThreshold(uint8).details: When quorumLocked is true, the threshold can only be increased, not decreased.      When zkEnabled is true, the number of configured verifiers must be ≥ threshold.

params.updater: New updater (must be non-zero). Reverts if updater is locked.

setVerifier(uint8,address).details: Setting to address(0) removes the verifier. Non-zero addresses must      have deployed code, support IRateVerifier via ERC-165, and not already      be assigned to another slot. Removal is blocked if it would violate an      active lock (zkEnabled requires ≥1 verifier; quorumLocked requires ≥threshold).

params.verifier: Verifier contract address, or address(0) to remove.

setZkEnabled(bool).details: When enabling: requires enough verifiers to satisfy the current quorum      threshold. When disabling: blocked if zkEnabledLocked is true.

params.enabled: True to require ZK proofs, false to allow plain updates.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

params.totalTVL_: Current total value locked (reserves backing hemiBTC).

returns._0: The (possibly unchanged) latest rate after validation.

updateRateWithProof(uint256,uint256,byte.details: Each verifier slot gets its own proof + extraData pair. Empty proof      (length 0) skips that slot. Non-empty proof for a slot whose verifier      is address(0) reverts. This function is always callable regardless of      the zkEnabled flag, allowing a transition period where both plain and      ZK-verified updates coexist.

params.proof0: Proof bytes for verifier slot 0 (empty to skip).
params.proof1: Proof bytes for verifier slot 1 (empty to skip).
params.proof2: Proof bytes for verifier slot 2 (empty to skip).

returns._0: The (possibly unchanged) latest rate after validation.

VERIFY_GAS_LIMIT.details: Maximum gas forwarded to each verifier.staticcall().      Prevents a malicious or buggy verifier from consuming all gas.

devdoc.title: HemiBTCRateProvider

getLastProofCount().notice: Returns the number of proofs that passed on the most recent accepted update.

getLatestTVL().notice: Returns the total value locked from the most recent accepted update.

getLatestTotalSupply().notice: Returns the total supply from the most recent accepted update.

getLatestUpdateTime().notice: Returns the timestamp of the most recent accepted update.

getMaxDifferencePercent().notice: Returns the maximum allowed TVL deviation (18-decimal fraction).

getRate().notice: Returns the current rate. Reverts if paused or no update has been accepted.

getState().notice: Returns a complete snapshot of the contract's state in a single call.

getUpdater().notice: Returns the current authorized updater address.

getVerifier(uint8).notice: Returns the verifier address at a given slot (0-2).

getVerifiers().notice: Returns all three verifier addresses as a fixed-size array.

initialize(address,address,uint256,uint2.notice: Initializes the rate provider (called once via the proxy).

isQuorumLocked().notice: Returns whether the quorum threshold is permanently locked.

isUpdaterLocked().notice: Returns whether the updater address is permanently locked.

isZkEnabled().notice: Returns whether ZK-only mode is enabled.

isZkEnabledLocked().notice: Returns whether ZK-only mode is permanently locked on.

lockQuorum().notice: Permanently prevent the quorum threshold from being lowered.

lockUpdater().notice: Permanently locks the current updater address. Once called,         `setUpdater` can never be called again — even by the owner.

lockZkEnabled().notice: Permanently lock zkEnabled = true. After this call, setZkEnabled(false) reverts.

pause().notice: Pause rate updates and rate reads in an emergency.

setMaxDifferencePercent(uint256).notice: Set the maximum allowed TVL deviation per update.

setQuorumThreshold(uint8).notice: Set the minimum number of proofs required per update (1-3).

setUpdater(address).notice: Set a new authorized updater address.

setVerifier(uint8,address).notice: Set or replace a verifier in a given slot (0-2).

setZkEnabled(bool).notice: Enable or disable ZK-only mode. When enabled, plain updateRate reverts.

unpause().notice: Resume normal operation after a pause.

updateRate(uint256,uint256).notice: Pushes a new rate snapshot (no ZK proof). Reverts if zkEnabled.

updateRateWithProof(uint256,uint256,byte.notice: Pushes a new rate snapshot verified by ZK proofs.

wasLastUpdateZkSecured().notice: Returns whether the most recent accepted update was ZK-verified.

userdoc.notice: Provides an on-chain exchange rate for hemiBTC by tracking total supply         and total value locked (TVL). An authorized updater pushes new snapshots;         the contract validates them against configurable bounds and maximum         per-update deviation before accepting a new rate.
